_comment: Baseline settings. Anything that varies per deployment, and everything secret, arrives as an environment variable named in custom-environment-variables.json. A setting that has only ever had one value belongs here, not in a new variable.

demo._comment: A throwaway tenant anybody can provision from the landing page, with no sign-up, deleted whole when it expires. OFF by default: it lets an unauthenticated visitor write to the same database the product runs on, which is a decision to take deliberately rather than inherit from a sample. max_live is the ceiling on how much of that database a bad afternoon can cost; per_ip_minutes keeps one visitor from spending the ceiling alone.

superadmin._comment: Bootstrapped on first boot when the users table is empty, so a fresh deployment has somebody who can create the first owner. Set a real password through the environment; the default one is refused outside development.
superadmin.name: Acme
